prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Render Pet Pose & Personality Preview Screen: Adds a new setup step before waiting where users select their pet's default desktop stance and dock position. (why: Adoption step drops to 68.0% conversion with 1017s mean time; adding clear preference previews sets expectations.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] Story First Express Onboarding Reorder: Reorders the story entry into a story scroll layout to engage users immediately before selecting paths. (why: Choose path median time is 8s but mean is 514s, indicating initial context confusion for a long tail of users.)
2: [home, wait_info] Interactive Desktop Docking Preview During Wait: Displays an interactive desktop diagram during asset generation showing the exact screen corner where the pet will spawn. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on desktop or users missing the initial spawn location.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop System Tray Pinning Alert Prompt: Displays an OS taskbar pinning reminder toast on the waiting screen to keep app controls accessible. (why: Users report losing track of desktop pet controls and app background states after setup.)

scores.note: Target step has high drop-off (68% conversion), but adding a new screen increases friction.
Addresses large mean-median time discrepancy, backed by funnel metrics only.
Strong evidence from both funnel wait times and multiple support tickets regarding spawn location.
Supported by user reports of lost app controls, implemented as a simple wait screen toast.
